tactile-paper.title: Accelerating Sparse Data Orchestration via Dynamic Reflexive Tiling
tactile-paper.locator_basis: PDF page 1 = proceedings page 18; PDF pages 4–9 = proceedings pages 21–26

drt-readme.edition_limit: Public revision not authenticated as the ASPLOS2023 evaluated revision.

drt-scheduler.edition_limit: Public revision not authenticated as the ASPLOS2023 evaluated revision.

task.locator: PDF p4 §3, Eq2; p7 §4.3; p8 Fig5
task.statement: One task pairs A(I,K) and B(K,J) over shared parent-relative K bounds. Fig5 declares DRAM→LLB J→K→I (CSC/CSC), LLB→PE K→I→J (CSC/CSR), PE I→J→K (CSR/CSC).

layout.statement: Uniform physical microtiles have compressed segment/coordinate arrays; outer tiled compressed metadata includes microtile footprint bytes and pointers. Macrotiles collect microtiles logically. Fig5 uses illustrative 3×3 microtiles stored as CSR/CSC.

aggregate.statement: Static per-operand/output buffer partitions constrain Aggregate. It accumulates represented microtile footprints, follows co-tiling constraints, traverses compressed metadata in raster order, and reverses overflow growth. Evaluated vector width P=32 feeds a P-to-1 adder.

fallback.statement: Stationary tensors grow first; default grows contracted then uncontracted dimensions. Growth failure tries another dimension; initial constrained tile failure subdivides the most recent dimension recursively. Coarsened subdivisions occur at microtile granularity.

metadata.statement: Metadata Build constructs segment/coordinate arrays bottom-up for next-level T-[uc]+ macrotiles and rebases coordinates to zero, retaining footprints and microtile references.

distribution.statement: Distribution carries macrotiling metadata and selected microtile pointers/data to lower S-DOPs and schedules microtile pairs for PEs. Added buffer port overlaps distribution i with formation i+1; lower-level formation starts on arriving metadata. Hiding formation depends on processing rates.

reference.statement: Fig5 illustration uses 350B LLB, A/B 175B/150B, 160B PE buffer and A/B 80B/80B. Study1 references 30MB global/32KB local buffers; all studies preprocess 32×32 microtiles and fixed tensor partitions (example A5%,B45%,Z50%).
limitations: Figure illustration, reported evaluation configuration and example ratios are distinct; none establish legal tuning domains or a complete output binding.

evaluation.statement: Study1 cycle-level tile-extractor model uses queuing memory/NoC; correctness check compares output sparsity to MKL. Other accelerator baselines are idealized; SW analysis is oracle best-case. Accelergy estimates area/energy.
limitations: Sparsity comparison is not independently verified numeric-value correctness. No model built or executed here; no RTL or CPU ABI established.

entry.locator: README setup items1–3 and src descriptions
entry.statement: MKL-dependent simulator targets include SpMSpM_TACTile_twoInp with dynamic/static tiling, tensor partition, microtile shape and distribution options. scheduler_8.cpp models TACTile.
limitations: Documented setup only; no executed binary or verified option binding. README partition examples/defaults differ from paper examples.

run.statement: Run iterates code K then J then I, calls ExtractBTopTile, PreCalculateARowsSize, EarlyFetchBBasicTiles, ExtractATopTile, EarlyFetchABasicTiles, ScheduleMiddleDOT; evicts A/B/O via LLB calls and counts output/log traffic.
limitations: Eviction/accounting is not an observer-visible dirty-output protocol.

b-policy.statement: Dynamic B admits successive code-J rows over a fixed code-K interval using AccumulateSize(CSF), DoesFitInLLB and AddToLLB. Only if starting J=0 and all B rows fit does it extend K one column at a time; writes AReuse and OReuse.
limitations: No recursive paper fallback or zero-admission progress guarantee established in this function. DoesFitInLLB internals not inspected.

a-policy.statement: Ordinary non-ideal dynamic A admits rows with DoesFitInLLB(A,vecCommittedRows_ASize[i]) and AddToLLB. Precomputation uses full A footprint for serial/parallel tile build, otherwise A footprint filtered by nonempty B rows.
limitations: A admission does not itself check exact future output size or prove all output pressure resolved. Fixed partition setting must be verified at caller/LLB binding; non-ideal alone does not prove global partition immutability.

ideal-excluded.statement: The ideal LLB policy explicitly labels itself SoL. It initializes temporary output logs, computes output sizes, tests total capacity, then calls SetRatios/SetSizes for A/O repartitioning.
limitations: Excluded from ordinary online fixed-partition claims; no numeric-value oracle adopted.

scaffold.locator: src/scheduler_8.cpp:298 ScheduleMiddleDOT; 787 ExtractAMiddleTiles; 970 ExtractBMiddleTiles; 1085 updateBWLog; 1183–1273 and 1599–1692 extraction overhead; 1311–1400 EarlyFetchA/BBasicTiles; 1744–1808 AccumulateSize
scaffold.statement: Existing simulator scaffolding includes middle-level scheduling, byte-size accumulation, tile-build/extraction overhead models, bandwidth timing and early-fetch flags.
limitations: Function pointers identify existing scaffolding, not a port plan, verified timing, complete Metadata Build implementation or coherent CPU adapter.

binding-gap.statement: Coordinates, tensor membership and microtile references provide logical task association; a CPU binding still needs packet response association, ownership and release rules.
limitations: Proposed obligations, not claimed paper-defined tags or acknowledgment protocol.

records.scope: One Fig5 illustrative fixed-partition SpMSpM mapping through Aggregate, Metadata Build and Distribution; containing PE arithmetic excluded.

layouts.dram: A tiled-CSC K-major; B tiled-CSC J-major, each with footprints and microtile pointers
layouts.llb: A CSC / B CSR macrotiling metadata
layouts.pe_reference_only: A CSR / B CSC physical microtiles

software_supplies.description: Declare loop order, base points, initial shapes, physical microtile layout and footprint metadata, compatible compressed arrays, pointers and static per-tensor capacity allocations. No host ISA/register encodings established.

stages.description: Select logical macrotiles from compressed metadata by byte footprint and dimension constraints.
Build next-level segment/coordinate metadata bottom-up and rebase coordinates.
Supply required metadata and microtile references/data to next S-DOP; lower distributor schedules pairs for PEs.

result.description: Logical macrotile and lower-level work with tensor-relative bounds, membership, rebased metadata and microtile references; no CPU fetched-value array or numeric SpMSpM result returned by extractor.

identity.description: Parent coordinate intervals and A/B microtile pairing identify the mathematical work. Metadata rebasing requires preserving parent-base interpretation. A stable task/epoch/response identifier is an adapter obligation, not a source-specified wire format.

consumer_lifetime.description: Formation precedes completed distribution conceptually, with pipelined streaming allowed. Pointer reuse and buffer retirement require downstream ownership and all-response consumption rules; exact acknowledgment/drain events are unestablished.

requirements.description: Bind footprint units/accounting to actual stored microtiles, validate segment monotonicity, coordinates, pointer bounds and layout conversions.
A.K and B.K share identical parent-relative intervals; common output I/J ranges and dataflow base advancement must form complete nonduplicated work across tasks.
Bind fixed A/B/output capacities at every S-DOP; metadata/data occupancy and output spill accounting must fit the actual representation.
Resolve oversize initial constrained tiles, oversize minimum microtile, empty regions and zero-admission progress in pinned B/A code; paper fallback is not a demonstrated code guarantee.
Define dirty partial-output ownership, spill/merge visibility and observer completion.
Define task epoch, microtile ownership, all consumer release and safe reuse at each hierarchy level.
Bind delayed/reordered responses to exact tensor/tile/metadata slot; resolve backpressure, fault, cancellation and drain.
Specify address translation, legal aliases/writers, CPU coherence and completion before connecting to host memory.
Verify numeric outputs against a scalar/reference implementation for a future binding; paper sparsity validation is insufficient.
Authenticate exact evaluated code and inspect caller/LLB policy/layout binding before claiming equivalence to this Fig5 reference.

parameters.description: Evaluated Aggregate parallelism, not Fig5 fixed shape or legal domain.
Illustrative capacity only; output reserve is not fully bound by A/B labels.
Illustrative A/B split; remaining bytes do not establish an output protocol.
Illustrative PE reference outside extractor arithmetic.
Illustrative A/B split; no universal output-capacity rule inferred.
Study1/all-studies 32×32 preprocessing is separate from Fig5 3×3 illustration.
Future actual per-tensor deployment capacities remain unchosen.

policy_reconciliation.paper: Stationary-first and contracted-before-uncontracted growth, continue after growth failure, recursive initial-load fallback.
policy_reconciliation.source_b: Code-J growth, conditional code-K growth only after all B rows fit from J=0.
policy_reconciliation.source_a: Non-ideal branch checks precomputed A-row sizes; output reserve/pressure is a separate requirement.
policy_reconciliation.symbol_translation: Paper I=code I, paper K=code J, paper J=code K. This permutation aligns mathematical axes, not every compressed layout or policy.

implementation.description: Pinned README/scheduler source shows existing C++ simulator scaffolding; not built, executed, ported or authenticated as the 2023 evaluated commit.

bottleneck.description: Sparse fixed-coordinate tiles underoccupy partitions; larger capacity-admitted logical tiles can reduce rereads. Simultaneously dense constrained tiles require fallback; metadata/preprocessing and formation that cannot overlap can consume the reuse benefit. No workload speedup claimed.

v0_disposition.reason: Tile-work construction/admission is neither a CPU read result nor optional prefetch assistance. v0 can store prose but cannot query this role/result kind or distinguish co-tiling admission and downstream ownership.

gap.type_domains: Numeric payload/index widths remain unestablished; 32-word vector width and footprint byte counts are not type domains.
